## Single-Cell Data Analysis {#single-cell}

scGHSOM adapts the Growing Hierarchical Self-Organizing Map (GHSOM) for single-cell
data to enable hierarchical clustering and visualization while identifying significant
attributes that characterize cell subpopulations
[2025, PMID: [40811172](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40811172/)]. — Fang Yu

[Code](https://github.com/changlabtw/scGHSOM)

- [scGHSOM: A Hierarchical Framework for Single-Cell Data Clustering and Visualization](https://doi.org/10.1109/TCBBIO.2025.3593632)  
  *2026 · IEEE Transactions on Computational Biology and Bioinformatics*
- [Single-cell absolute contact probability detection reveals chromosomes are organized by multiple low-frequency yet specific interactions.](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-017-01962-x)  
  *2017 · Nature communications*

## Genome Organization {#3d-genome}

A topological screen in *Drosophila* cells lacking CTCF and Cp190 identifies hundreds
of insulator elements that modulate local chromatin interactions without driving global
genome folding, suggesting Cp190 functions by promoting insulator protein cobinding
rather than loop formation
[2023, PMID: [36735780](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36735780/)]. — Yuri B. Schwartz

Repressed TADs are 3D structural units of chromosome organization in *Drosophila*
[2018, [PMID: 295038](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/?term=29503869)]. — Giacomo Cavalli

- [Topological screen identifies hundreds of Cp190- and CTCF-dependent Drosophila chromatin insulator elements](https://doi.org/10.1126/sciadv.ade0090)  
  *2023 · Science Advances*
- [Pattern recognition of topologically associating domains using deep learning](https://doi.org/10.1186/s12859-022-05075-1)  
  *2022 · BMC Bioinformatics*
- [HiCmapTools: a tool to access HiC contact maps](https://doi.org/10.1186/s12859-022-04589-y)  
  *2022 · BMC Bioinformatics*
- [TADs are 3D structural units of higher-order chromosome organization in Drosophila](https://doi.org/10.1126/sciadv.aar8082)  
  *2018 · Science Advances*

## Computational Protein Function Prediction {#protein-function}

Position-Specific Scoring Matrices (PSSMs) contain richer information than primary
sequences and can be efficiently generated by searching the UniRef50 database with
reduced sensitivity parameters
[[PMID:24146760](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/?term=24146760)].

Dimensionality reduction techniques, such as PLSA, CA, and PCA, not only enhance model
performance but also uncover latent relationships within the data
[[PMID:18260102](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/?term=18260102),
[PMID:24146760](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/?term=24146760)].

- [GODoc: high-throughput protein function prediction using novel k-nearest-neighbor and voting algorithms](https://doi.org/10.1186/s12859-020-03556-9)  
  *2020 · BMC Bioinformatics*

## Sequence Alignment & Phylogenetics {#alignment-phylogenetics}

Sampling alignment columns across alternative aligners enhances the discriminative power
of bootstrap support regarding tree topology correctness
[2019, [PMID:30726875](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/?term=30726875)]. — Cedric Notredame

The reliability of Multiple Sequence Alignments (MSA) can be robustly quantified using
the Transitive Consistency Score (TCS), which is derived from the T-Coffee pairwise
library. — Cedric Notredame

- method [2014, [PMID: 24694831](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/?term=24694831)]
- server [2015, [PMID: 25855806](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/?term=25855806)]
